The confusion matrix will be 3x3 because there are 3 classes in the iris dataset, but the display_labels only has 2 elements, which causes the mismatch.

To fix this, I need to:
1. Get the actual class labels from the data or the classifier
2. Use those labels in the display_labels parameter
